Act11-1a#1.zh: ...这么说兄弟你这一票可捞了不少啊？
Act11-1a#1.t: ...So, brother, you made a fat haul this time?

Act11-1a#2.zh: 托大哥的福，小弟的确几个月不用开张了。晁保正虽然人称『托塔天王』，但是干起这偷鸡摸狗的事也十分行啊！还有那个『智多星』吴用，设计谋连孔明都不如他啊！刚才他们领头的汉子怀疑酒中有蒙汗药，要不是吴用先生要我将计就计，大概会被他识破...
Act11-1a#2.t: Thanks to you, big brother, I won't need to work for months. Headman Chao may be called the 'Pagoda King', but he's mighty good at this sneaky business too! And that 'Wizard' Wu Yong, even Kongming couldn't plan like him! Their leader suspected the wine was drugged; if Master Wu hadn't had me play along, he'd probably have seen through it...

Act11-1a#3.zh: 哈哈哈...兄弟做了这么大买卖，实在值得庆祝！来，喝酒喝酒...
Act11-1a#3.t: Hahaha... a deal this big really calls for a celebration! Come, drink, drink...

Act11-1a#4.t: Great King! Someone's attacking the mountain!

Act11-1a#5.zh: 在下『%M』%N，不知贵寨是否对这位杨兄弟押解的官银动手？如果是，希望能将官银全数送还，大家凭著江湖义气，就此罢休。
Act11-1a#5.t: I am '%M' %N. Did your stronghold lay hands on the official silver this Brother Yang was escorting? If so, I hope you'll return all of it, and by the code of the rivers and lakes we'll leave it at that.

Act11-1a#6.zh: 哈哈！你有听说过被吃下去的东西还有吐出来的道理吗？...白胜，你看看那些人中有没有熟悉的面孔？
Act11-1a#6.t: Haha! Have you ever heard of spitting out what's already been swallowed? ...Bai Sheng, any familiar faces among them?

Act11-1a#7.zh: 啊...那个青脸的汉子就是负责押解『生辰纲』的领队！可是其他那些凶神恶煞我可没有见过，他从哪里找来这么多帮手的？邓大哥救我！他们一定是来捉我的！
Act11-1a#7.t: Ah... that blue-faced man is the leader who escorted the 'birthday gifts'! But I've never seen those other fierce-looking brutes. Where did he find so many helpers? Brother Deng, save me! They must have come to catch me!

Act11-1a#8.zh: 救你是可以...可是你的金银珠宝我要一半。
Act11-1a#8.t: I can save you... but I want half your gold and jewels.

Act11-1a#9.t: Half?! Big brother, that's too harsh!

Act11-1a#13.t: Just my luck! All right, I agree!

Act11-1a#14.zh: 啊...那个獐头鼠目的家伙就是卖酒的人！『生辰纲』一定在这里！
Act11-1a#14.t: Ah... that shifty-looking fellow is the wine seller! The 'birthday gifts' must be here!

Act11-1a#15.zh: 『%M』！就算本大王『金眼虎』邓龙抢了货物，你又能拿我怎么样？你们只有区区几个人，就敢来本山寨理论？真是活得不耐烦了！小子们！给我上！
Act11-1a#15.t: '%M'! So I, 'Golden-eyed Tiger' Deng Long, took the goods. What can you do about it? Just a handful of you, and you dare come to my stronghold to argue? You must be tired of living! Boys! Get them!

Act11-1a#16.zh: 你能不能打败『金眼虎』邓龙？
Act11-1a#16.t: Can you defeat 'Golden-eyed Tiger' Deng Long?
